name: live_strip
description: The rolling strip: a trailing series at the live cadence of the sampled throughput by traffic direction, and of the logged decisions per engine -- allowed, refused by a firewall rule, refused with no rule, refused for a reason not recorded, refused by a resolver's list -- each decision series complete up to its source's last healthy pass and a gap after it, never a zero. It reads stored samples and records, renews the live-interest lease and never calls the firewall.
